description: This Java class 'InboundMappingProcessor' handles processing of incoming external messages within the Eclipse Ditto project. It performs content-type filtering, condition checking, message mapping, header processing, and error handling, encapsulating the logic needed to convert external messages into internal signals based on configured mappings.

classes.name: InboundMappingProcessor
classes.description: A final class that processes incoming external messages, applies message mappings, and converts them into signals or errors based on configuration and content.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate an InboundMappingProcessor with provided connection details, mapping definitions, actor system, configuration, protocol adapter, and logger.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes an ExternalMessage, applying configured mappers to generate mapping outcomes, possibly resulting in mapped messages or errors.

methods.name: runMapper
methods.description: Executes individual message mappers on the external message, producing a stream of mapping outcomes.

methods.name: resolveDittoHeadersBestEffort
methods.description: Attempts to build Ditto headers from the message headers and payload, used for error handling and processing.

methods.name: toDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Converts an exception into a DittoRuntimeException, attaching relevant headers and context.

methods.name: shouldMapMessageByContentType
methods.description: Checks whether the message's content type passes filtering conditions based on blocklists.

methods.name: shouldMapMessageByConditions
methods.description: Evaluates whether the message satisfies incoming conditions set by the mapper.

methods.name: filterByContentTypeBlocklist
methods.description: Creates a predicate function to filter out blocked content types per mapper.

methods.name: isNullOrEmpty
methods.description: Utility method to check if a collection is null or empty.
